Hawaii Vacation Packing List
Based on Emma Johnson's Hawaii Trip (June 10-20, 2024)

Essential Items:
- Swimwear
- Sunscreen
- Hiking gear
- Casual outfits
- Camera
- Travel documents

Additional Recommended Items:
- Beach towel
- Sunglasses
- Hat or cap for sun protection
- Light rain jacket (for possible showers)
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip flops/sandals
- Reusable water bottle
- Snorkeling gear (optional, can be rented at Hanauma Bay)
- Light sweater for cooler evenings
- Insect repellent
- First aid kit
- Chargers for electronic devices
- Travel adapter if needed
- Cash and credit cards
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Flight tickets/boarding passes
- Travel insurance information
